title: Decision: INSERT OR IGNORE for idempotent chat/contact creation
description: Both chat.rs (line 28) and contact.rs (lines 31-35) use INSERT OR IGNORE / INSERT OR REPLACE to safely retry operations without duplicating state. This is a load-bearing design choice: Peer/deliver can be retried safely, and get_or_create is idempotent across multiple callers. Rejected alternative: error on duplicate would require caller-side dedup logic.
